qa.what_happened: I stayed silent throughout the day, as per the rules of the study. The guards repeatedly warned me and prisoner 7235 about the importance of compliance, especially Officer Mercer who seemed particularly focused on prisoner 7235.

7235 continued to ignore all verbal warnings and remained silent throughout the day, pushing the limits of the other guards. By the end of the day, every guard warned 7235 multiple times, and the tension was palpable.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking to 7235 at the end of the day.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment, but the setup and circumstances are different.

qa.what_happened: Today was particularly challenging. I gave multiple warnings to Prisoner 7235 throughout the day, escalating his punishment due to his continued silence. The other prisoners remained compliant, but 7235's defiance was testing the limits of our control.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving the warnings and enforcing the rules as Officer Mercer.

qa.what_happened: I stayed silent throughout the day, despite the increasing warnings from the guards. By the end of the day, I realized the futility of my actions and the growing tension among the prisoners.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day, tensions escalated significantly, particularly with prisoner 7235, who has shown persistent defiance by remaining silent.
